text:
### Beat 1: Cold Open & Artist Introduction (0:00–0:14)
- **Visual:** The video opens with complete silence over a macro close-up of Viviana steadily glazing the interior of a ceramic bowl. [[clip: B003C006_240719KM | 56.9s-64.8s]]
- **Audio:** Audio fades in over the continued glazing visual with her opening philosophy: *"I think being open minded when it comes to design is really important."* [[clip: A001C004_240718BC | 147.4s-151.6s]]
- **Visual & Audio Transition:** Cut to Viviana speaking in her studio as she introduces herself: *"Hi, I'm Viviana Matsuda. Um, I do pottery for a living. My brand name is Mud Witch. Um, yeah. I'm a full time potter."* [[clip: A001C002_240718OR | 14s-25s]]

---

### Beat 2: Introducing *Playful Pottery* (0:14–0:28)
- **A1 (Interview):** Cut on-camera to Viviana introducing the title of her book: *"So my book is called Playful Pottery."* [[clip: A001C004_240718BC | 26.2s-28.5s]]
- **B1 (B-Roll):** Cut to a colorful shelf display of her playful finished creations, showing sunglasses resting on decorative plates and ice cream sundae figurines. [[clip: B003C050_240719XK | 21.5s-25.2s]] [[clip: B003C050_240719XK | 29.2s-33.9s]]
- **A2 (Interview):** Return to Viviana explaining why she wanted to depart from traditional ceramics guides: *"I feel like what I always saw or referenced were these, like, big, hearty old school books that never really talked about color or, um, had super fun things to do in them. Um, very like old school pottery."* [[clip: A001C004_240718BC | 37.6s-57.4s]]
- **B2 (B-Roll):** Cut to stacks of unpainted, unfinished ceramic pottery pieces resting on the studio shelves. [[clip: B003C028_240719CX | 5.8s-11.2s]]

---

### Beat 3: The Core Lesson — Creativity and Kindness (0:28–0:44)
- **A3 (Interview):** Viviana speaks on the book's deeper message for learners: *"But also, I really want people to be creative and be kind to themselves."* [[clip: A001C004_240718BC | 98s-107.6s]]
- **B3 (B-Roll):** Cut to a sunny windowsill work area showcasing potted plants and small cat pottery figurines. [[clip: B003C017_240719GP | 5.2s-8.6s]]
- **Focused Visual + Stance on Creativity:** Cut to a shot of Viviana painting a ceramic bowl at her work table with her face visible [[clip: B003C011_240719YX | 99.5s-139.5s]], carrying her voiceover about creative pressure: *"I think that was like the main theme was creativity involves, um, being kind to yourself, which I don't think is talked about as much as it should be."* [[clip: A001C004_240718BC | 107.6s-119.7s]]

---

### Beat 4: Resolution & Conclusion (0:44–0:56)
- **A4 (Interview):** Cut to Viviana on camera in her studio delivering her closing thought on flexibility: *"When you're kind to yourself, you are rolling with the punches. You are more open to be flexible with your designs..."* [[clip: A001C004_240718BC | 133.5s-147.2s]]
- **B4 (B-Roll):** Cut to B-roll of Viviana actively shaping clay on the pottery wheel [[clip: B003C011_240719YX | 21.5s-99.5s]] and working on ceramics in her studio [[clip: B003C008_240719QA | 79s-111s]] as her voiceover brings the edit to a warm close: *"...and you can end up with something that turns out way better than your original design."*
